title.zh: 规定1901年度身份证税在各省内应缴期限可由省财政官酌情延至1902年1月1日的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE TIME WITHIN WHICH THE CEDULA TAX FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND ONE SHALL BE DUE AND PAYABLE IN EACH PROVINCE MAY BE EXTENDED IN THE DISCRETION OF THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER TO A PERIOD NOT LATER THAN THE FIRST DAY OF JANUARY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE TIME WITHIN WHICH THE CEDULA TAX FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND ONE SHALL BE DUE AND PAYABLE IN EACH PROVINCE MAY BE EXTENDED IN THE DISCRETION OF THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER TO A PERIOD NOT LATER THAN THE FIRST DAY OF JANUARY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định thời hạn nộp thuế giấy chứng nhận cá nhân năm 1901 tại mỗi tỉnh có thể được gia hạn theo quyết định của Giám đốc Tài chính Tỉnh đến không muộn hơn ngày 1 tháng 1 năm 1902
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดว่าระยะเวลาที่ต้องชำระภาษีซีดูลาประจำปี๑๙๐๑ในแต่ละจังหวัดอาจขยายออกไปตามดุลยพินิจของผู้อำนวยการคลังจังหวัดจนถึงวันที่๑เดือนมกราคม๑๙๐๒
title.id: Undang-Undang Menetapkan bahwa jangka waktu pembayaran pajak cedula tahun 1901 di setiap provinsi dapat diperpanjang menurut kebijaksanaan Direktur Keuangan Provinsi hingga paling lambat tanggal 1 Januari 1902
title.ms: Akta Menetapkan Bahawa Tempoh Bayaran Cukai Cedulabagi Tahun 1901 di Setiap Wilayah Boleh Dilanjutkan Mengikut Pertimbangan Pengarah Kewangan Wilayah Sehingga Tarikh Terakhir 1 Januari 1902

text.en:
The treasurer of any province is hereby authorized, in his discretion, to extend the time within
which the cedula tax for the year nineteen hundred and one shall be due and payable in hi,s province to a
period not later than the first day of January, nineteen hundred and two, by posting notices in four
conspicuous places in each municipality of the province, and at the door of the provincial building, stating
that such postponement has been made. In the provinces where such postponement shall be made as in this
section provided, persons failing to pay the cedula tax within the time originally fixed by the provincial
treasurer in accordance with law, but who shall pay the same before the date fixed by the treasurer for the
expiration of the extension of the time as provided in this Act, shall not be subject to the penalties provided
in section thirty of Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-three, any provisions in said Act Numbered One
hundred and thirty-three to the contrary notwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 24, 1901.
